status: declared by the pull request that closes #375; the bar is Eleonora's replacement ruling of 7 October 2026 on #375 (the success bar is replaced); the cut-offs and tier limits were fixed before any candidate was scored, but the week-ahead combiner was changed from independence to the maximum after the benchmark rows' calibration was seen under the first (see the pull request); the other choices that ruling leaves open (what a false alarm is, how the lead-at-least readings combine horizons, the scheduled risk dates, how calibration by regime is tested, the baseline rows' cut-offs, the bootstrap block length, the usefulness preference) are listed in that pull request for her review; amended by the pull request that closes #407: the flag cut-off is no longer declared per candidate (the fixed 0.2 placeholder) but chosen at each refit and horizon from that refit's training window alone by cutoff_rule, calibration by regime in tier 3 is tested only in regimes with a pressure day, and a pass within the scarce regime is reported beside the pass rule; the tiers' limits, the pass rule and the confirmation look are unchanged; the candidates of the onset classifier (#409) are added, declared in metadata/onset_classifier.json before any was scored

cutoff_rule.amended_by: the pull request that closes #407, under Eleonora's ruling of 8 October 2026 on #374 (replaces the fixed 0.2 placeholder cut-off)
cutoff_rule.choice: the cut-off with the highest onset recall whose false alarms per onset on the refit's training window are at most the limit; of cut-offs with the same recall, the highest
cutoff_rule.training_window: the forecast's own earlier walk-forward probabilities on the scored days whose outcome was known at the refit's first decision instant (up to the business day before it), from the first scored day; the same for every candidate and benchmark, at each threshold and horizon
